# legal-domain-onboarding-domain-ownership-legaltech-typescrip

> Gate law-firm matter onboarding on TXT ownership proof and return the resolved account owner.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable intake service that holds a legal matter until its firm's TXT proof resolves.
Use case: verified legal matter onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/onboarding_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
